tickets.title: University Email Registration
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to register using my university email address, so that only verified students can access the marketplace.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Registration requires a valid .edu email address.
- The system verifies the email format.
- Accounts with non-.edu emails are rejected.
- PASS: A user with a valid .edu email can register successfully.
- FAIL: A user with a non-.edu email can create an account.

tickets.title: Barcode Item Listing
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to scan a product barcode, so that item details can be filled automatically when creating a listing.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The camera can scan a barcode.
- Item information is retrieved automatically when available.
- Students can edit retrieved information before publishing.
- PASS: Item details are populated after a successful scan.
- FAIL: The system does not retrieve item information.

tickets.title: Safe Exchange Zone Selection
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to choose a safe exchange zone before contacting a seller, so that meetups occur in approved locations.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The system displays approved exchange zones.
- A zone must be selected before chat becomes available.
- Selected zones are visible to both parties.
- PASS: Chat is enabled only after a zone is selected.
- FAIL: Users can chat without selecting a safe zone.
